scoring_justification: Cannot fully recompute from raw data; the artifact is the final computed ranges, so compare agent's reported ranges to the correctly computed values derived from the paper's constants.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold expected ksi ranges for each contribution
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper's Conrad equations and given constants (μ, b, a0, α3, Δ(ρ^1/2), Δ(1/λ), Δf, α range, unit conversion factor 1.45e-8 ksi per dyn/cm²)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Calculated in checker's prepare function using the same formulas and constants as the paper, and matching the solve.sh reference.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly computed from the paper's authoritative constants, not invented.

schema.description: Each row gives the name of the contribution, and the computed minimum and maximum values in dyn/cm² and ksi.

outputs.description: Ausforming strength contributions: Δτρ (dislocation density), Δτλ (particle spacing), Δτf (interstitial loss), their sum, and the tensile yield increment Δσ = 2×sum.

output_contract.notes: All input constants and formulas are given in the step. The scores will be compared against the paper-reported ranges with a reasonable tolerance.
